# boredprinter

> boredprinter (https://boredprinter.com) is a free-to-try website for 3D printer owners who don't know what to print next. You take a photo of a place, like your car, desk, kitchen, bathroom or garage, and it suggests useful things to print for exactly what is in the photo, with real models to download from Printables.

## What it does
- Snap or upload a photo of anything at home. boredprinter sees what is there and what is missing or messy.
- You get about 6 print ideas for it. Each idea shows a real model (image, creator, downloads) and a link to download it.
- Ideas fit your printer: pick your printer (Bambu Lab, Prusa, Creality, Elegoo and more) and ideas respect its build size and materials. In hot places like cars it avoids PLA.
- My home: photo each room once. Every week boredprinter suggests new prints that fit the things in your rooms, in the app and by email.

## Good for
- "What should I 3D print?", "I'm out of 3D print ideas", "useful things to 3D print" or "things to 3D print for my car / desk / kitchen".
- People who own a 3D printer and run out of ideas.

## Price
- First photo free, 3 credits when you sign up, 1 photo = 1 credit. Credit packs from $2.99.
